title: White House AI Rally Update: The Next Targets On Nvidia And Palantir
speaker: Nick Valdez

macro_themes.view: Stocks of CEOs at the Sept 30 White House AI meeting are surging and have further upside to next pivot/pattern targets.
Pro-business result in Brazil's first round lifted its market sharply; bullish for Brazilian names like NU.

calls.reason: Pushing up again toward prior Sept 22 rejection level ~347; area to take some profits, could creep to ~350.
calls.quote: I am watching this level for Apple. This could be a potential area for, you know, maybe some profits if we continue to push up.

calls.reason: Broke above long-standing pivot line in the sand; next level is the June 30 pivot high ~172, which price is pushing into.
calls.quote: I would just simply go to the next pivot high. It's going to be from the June 30th high. That's right around 172.

calls.reason: Descending trend line from July 2025 sits around 541; next level if the post-meeting rally continues (~6% further).
calls.quote: that level if we're to continue, uh this is going to be right around 541.

calls.reason: Prior 195 target hit; inverse head and shoulders measured move targets ~263-264 after a breakout and retest of the neckline; take profits/short there.
calls.quote: that level is going to be right around $263, 264... that's definitely going to be an area to take some profits

calls.reason: Loose inverse head and shoulders at a pivot resistance; a ~20% run-up projects to ~276.
calls.quote: If we do see a you know, a run up, you're looking at right around $276.

calls.reason: Rallying since the AI summit; pivot top ~796 next to the $800 psychological level could be tested soon.
Brazil election optimism (pro-business candidate) and Berkshire ownership; expects price to knock on the next pivot top within 24 hours and then a higher pivot.
calls.quote: Might be knocking on this door within the next 24 hours.

notes: No explicit date; host refers to 'Friday' as the last session and to Brazil's first-round vote (Oct 4), so possibly Monday Oct 5 rather than listing Oct 6. Chipotle (CMG) bounce call from that morning ('hit our $30 target', gap fill + 0.786 retrace) was already played out and he says it is flattening; not recorded. No price levels given for NU. MELI mentioned in passing.
